description: Javno preduzeće za nacionalne parkove Crne Gore: dams and flood defences datasets is a collection of datasets listed in DATA.GOV.ME, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Javno preduzeće za nacionalne parkove Crne Gore. Coverage: Javno preduzeće za nacionalne parkove Crne Gore. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about dams and flood defences; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Plan upravljanja NP Skadarsko jezero 2021-2025; Pregled značajnih vrsta ornitofaune u NP Skadarsko jezero; Program upravljanja NP Skadarko jezero 2024. Formats seen: PDF, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-me.
